tour.title: How to use the Swarm tab

step1.title: This is the Swarm tab
step1.body: Advanced: a coordination board for multiple AI agents working on one git repository. They coordinate by committing small status files into a .gnap/ folder — a shared to-do board, agent list, and message log inside your repo.

step2.title: Start a swarm
step2.body: Click [NEW SWARM] to point it at a git repo and register agents and tasks. It writes only inside .gnap/, so your code is safe. Use [OPEN EXISTING] to reattach to one you already made.

step3.title: What you will see
step3.body: Once open, the dashboard shows three panes: the agents (who is working), a kanban board (tasks moving across stages), and a live feed of every commit. It updates as the agents work.

step4.title: When to use it
step4.body: Swarm is a coordination board for multiple agents working on one repo — it tracks tasks, agents, and commits in a shared .gnap/ folder. It is experimental and more involved than the Code tab. If you just want one agent, use Code. Reopen this from "How to".
